rename.rule: KLGJ is historical provenance only. New files, reports and spoken references use PIPPI.

JUXTAPOSE.role: Preposition pivots and expose exact route/order space for calibration.

M2R_PM.role: Immutable exact experience memory and context-conditioned movement/resource statistics.

JGPT_TEACHER.role: Full-capacity Pivot-Slime/Keymaster route and resource teacher.

PIVOT_SLIME.role: Compact pivot scout and next-route proposer distilled/calibrated from exact-backed teacher data.

TOPA_DETECTIVE_SPIDER.role: SPIDER weaves relation graphs; TOPA CORE attacks unsupported transfer/confounding/provenance defects.

KEYMASTER.role: Global pivot navigator and memory arbiter; chooses which exact route to try first.

PIPPI.role: Append-only learning/resource history from zero forward. Quantifies measured gains, costs, regressions, effective capacity and slowdown.

PIPPI_SPIDER.role: Continuous provenance chunking and graph weaving over PIPPI history.
PIPPI_SPIDER.relation_promotion: SPIDER observed edge -> TOPA CORE falsification -> holdout-replicated advisory heuristic; independent exact proof required for theorem status.

PIPPI_MIRROR.role: End-of-cycle reflection read by Pivot-Slime and Keymaster before the next pass.

canonical_cycle: 0. PIPPI opens the cycle with frozen baseline, previous mirror and accounting horizon.
1. JUXTAPOSE/Exact JANUS exposes exact route receipts.
2. M2R-PM stores exact experiences and retrieves structurally related history.
3. JGPT teacher learns exact-backed route/resource targets.
5. TOPA DETECTIVE SPIDER observes both active logs and PIPPI, continuously forming provenance chunks and candidate relations.
6. TOPA CORE attacks Spider relations for confounding, leakage, replay inflation and unsupported causality.
7. Keymaster fuses M2R, JGPT, Slime, surviving Detective hypotheses, current cap and previous PIPPI mirror into ranked candidate routes.
8. Exact JANUS replay alone decides the attempted route/pivot semantics.
9. PIPPI appends exact result, resource spend, training cost, comparable gains/regressions and checkpoint metadata.
10. PIPPI Spider closes/updates affected chunks, searches cross-chunk relations and submits them to TOPA CORE.
11. PIPPI MIRROR is generated with separated EXACT_FACT / DETECTIVE_HYPOTHESIS / TOPA_REJECTED / UNKNOWN sections.
12. Pivot-Slime reads the mirror to understand which exact-backed behaviors improved, regressed or remain uncertain before proposing the next pass.
13. Keymaster reads the same mirror to understand route efficiency, resource growth, repeated waste and slowing before ranking the next pass.
14. Next cycle starts; mirror context may alter search order and exploration priorities, never truth/proof semantics.
mirror_learning_questions: What did we demonstrably learn this pass on matched exact data?
Which gain came from lower exact checks, lower pair work, lower raw peak, better overflow avoidance or shorter terminal depth?
What did training/calibration cost to obtain that gain?
Which apparent relations survived TOPA CORE and which were rejected?
What did Slime predict correctly/incorrectly and what regret remained?
What did Keymaster route correctly/incorrectly and where did it waste exact checks?
Did effective search capacity grow, stay flat or regress?
Is marginal gain slowing or plateauing?
What unexplained delta should Spider investigate in the next pass?
